validation_note: Internal held-out test checks only. This model has not been independently validated for factual truth, unseen publishers, future news, or translated and multilingual articles.
evaluation_method: Random stratified train-test split after exact-text deduplication. Related articles and source-specific patterns may still overlap.

dataset_documentation.source: University of Victoria ISOT Fake News Dataset / Open Research News Corpus
dataset_documentation.components: True.csv (Reuters/AP journalistic coverage) and Fake.csv (flagged deceptive claims)
dataset_documentation.terms_note: Dataset files are excluded from Git repository tracking via .gitignore.

disclaimer: Pratyora predictions are statistical lexical pattern estimates. They evaluate rhetorical and lexical patterns in training text, not factual truth or falsehood. Never use as a standalone fact-checking engine.
